mapper.insert: INSERT INTO moondap.md_visit_daily (visit_date, visit_count) VALUES (#{visitDate}, 1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE visit_count = visit_count + 1
INSERT IGNORE INTO moondap.md_visit_log (visit_date, ip_address, first_seen_at) VALUES (#{visitDate}, #{ipAddress}, NOW())
INSERT INTO moondap.md_visit_daily (visit_date, participation_count) VALUES (#{visitDate}, 1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE participation_count = participation_count + 1
INSERT INTO moondap.md_pageview_hourly (visit_date, visit_hour, view_count) VALUES (#{visitDate}, #{visitHour}, 1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE view_count = view_count + 1

INSERT INTO moondap.md_pageview_path (visit_date, path, view_count, entry_count) VALUES (#{visitDate}, #{path}, 1, #{entry}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE view_count = view_count + 1, entry_count = entry_count + #{entry}
INSERT INTO moondap.md_referrer_daily (visit_date, source, visit_count) VALUES (#{visitDate}, #{source}, 1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE visit_count = visit_count + 1
INSERT IGNORE INTO moondap.md_visit_cookie (visit_date, anon_id, first_seen_at) VALUES (#{visitDate}, #{anonId}, NOW())

INSERT INTO moondap.md_user_agent_daily (visit_date, user_agent, counted, hit_count) VALUES (#{visitDate}, #{userAgent}, #{counted}, 1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE hit_count = hit_count + 1, counted = #{counted}
mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(visit_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS visitDate, COALESCE(visit_count, 0) AS visitCount, COALESCE(participation_count, 0) AS participationCount FROM moondap.md_visit_daily WHERE visit_date BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate} ORDER BY visit_date ASC
SELECT visit_hour AS visitHour, SUM(view_count) AS viewCount FROM moondap.md_pageview_hourly WHERE visit_date BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate} GROUP BY visit_hour ORDER BY visit_hour ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(visit_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS visitDate, COUNT(*) AS cookieVisitorCount FROM moondap.md_visit_cookie WHERE visit_date BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate} GROUP BY visit_date ORDER BY visit_date ASC

SELECT path, SUM(view_count) AS viewCount, SUM(entry_count) AS entryCount FROM moondap.md_pageview_path WHERE visit_date BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate} GROUP BY path ORDER BY viewCount DESC, path ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT path, SUM(view_count) AS viewCount, SUM(entry_count) AS entryCount FROM moondap.md_pageview_path WHERE visit_date BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate} GROUP BY path HAVING entryCount > 0 ORDER BY entryCount DESC, path ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT source, SUM(visit_count) AS visitCount FROM moondap.md_referrer_daily WHERE visit_date BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate} GROUP BY source ORDER BY visitCount DESC, source ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM moondap.md_visit_log WHERE visit_date < #{cutoffDate}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM moondap.md_visit_cookie WHERE visit_date < #{cutoffDate}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM moondap.md_visit_log WHERE visit_date = #{visitDate}
